## Context

**Storian:** ADB, UNDP, SPC and partners – risk information and development/investment planning

**VBoS role:** Nominated to share our work on climate and disaster risk databases

**Focus:** Strengthening use of risk information in planning, budgeting, preparedness, and recovery

---

## VBoS Mandate

- Support provincial and area council planning and budgeting
- Provide statistical and geospatial information for decision-making
- Integrate climate and disaster risk data into planning processes

---

## Disaster Risk Management Information System (DRMIS)

**What it is:** Web-based geospatial platform for climate and disaster risk information

**Status:** Operational – deployed for testing; ready for NDMO/MoCCA training

**Users:** Provincial administrators, area councils, NDMO, sector ministries

---

## DRMIS – Core Capabilities

- **Interactive maps:** Disaster and climate modes; multiple layer types (raster, vector, PMTiles)
- **Damage estimates:** Hazard damage, financial damage, response resources
- **Climate modules:** Land cover, coastal shorelines, cyclone intensity
- **Area data entry:** Provincial/area council input with offline support
- **Field checks:** Damage verification by area administrators via MIS (web/PWA, offline support; confidence % tracked)
- **Export:** XLSX, PDF for reporting and budgeting

---

## Risk Information → Planning & Investment

| Use case | How DRMIS supports it |
|---------|------------------------|
| **Planning** | Baseline + damage estimates inform provincial and area council plans |
| **Budgeting** | Financial damage estimates support resource allocation |
| **Preparedness** | Response resources and hazard layers support preparedness planning |
| **Recovery** | Post-event damage data informs recovery and reconstruction |

---

## Data Integration

- **Baseline:** Land cover, coastal shorelines, infrastructure
- **Damage estimates:** From past events (e.g. cyclones)
- **Climate:** Land accounts, coastal changes, cyclone tracks
- **Response:** Aid, shelters, health facilities

*Single platform – multiple data sources*

---

## Deployment & Next Steps

- **Domain:** drmis.ndmo.gov.vu (pending DCDT/Vodafone setup)
- **Training:** Shefa training, VBoS training of MoCCA staff – ready to begin
- **Feedback:** Continuous improvement; user feedback built in

---

## Opportunities for Collaboration

- **Shared datasets:** Standardised baselines for joint use
- **Common standards:** Align data formats and taxonomies
- **Capacity building:** Joint training on risk information
- **Field verification:** Collaborate on damage verification workflows
